mundane.description:
Ordinary goods from a convenience store, clothing floor or home.

New equippable items may have up to 1 bonus picks. Prefer suitable bonuses; zero bonuses is valid. Never invent unsupported mechanics. Non-equippable items receive no equipment bonuses. Use low-to-mid world trait examples for the same type and target; explicit creator limits take priority.
mundane.rarityGuidance: Common everyday goods, broadly available in hero society.

artisan.description:
Well-made, specialist or issued gear: school kit, electronics, tools and common support items.

New equippable items may have up to 2 bonus picks. Prefer suitable bonuses; zero bonuses is valid. Never invent unsupported mechanics. Non-equippable items receive no equipment bonuses. Use low-to-mid world trait examples for the same type and target; explicit creator limits take priority.
artisan.rarityGuidance: Uncommon goods from specialist shops, schools and support companies.

special.description:
Licensed support gear, hero costumes, restricted weapons and other things most people cannot simply buy.

New equippable items may have up to 3 bonus picks. Prefer suitable bonuses; zero bonuses is valid. Never invent unsupported mechanics. Non-equippable items receive no equipment bonuses. Use low-to-mid world trait examples for the same type and target; explicit creator limits take priority.
special.rarityGuidance: Rare items that need a license, an agency, a school or the black market.

legendary.description:
Prototypes and items at the very top of hero society, unique in the world.

New equippable items may have up to 4 bonus picks. Prefer suitable bonuses; zero bonuses is valid. Never invent unsupported mechanics. Non-equippable items receive no equipment bonuses. Use low-to-mid world trait examples for the same type and target; explicit creator limits take priority.
legendary.rarityGuidance: Unique items placed deliberately by the creator.
